purpose: Apply S28/S29 as advisory review guidance to currently open Dependabot PRs without updating, merging or changing dependency branches.

usage_observation.notes: S28 classified Dependabot PR bodies, release links and GitHub check output as external/tool data rather than instructions. S29 classified setup-node, Blume and TypeScript as CI/docs-build/compiler trust-boundary surfaces. All three PRs showed green checks at review time, but all were behind main, so merge should wait for branch update and refreshed validation.

gaps.gap: PRs #422, #423 and #424 had successful historical CI but mergeStateStatus=BEHIND at review time.
This review did not update branches, rerun post-update checks, merge dependencies or validate upstream release content beyond local PR metadata and changed-file surfaces.
Repeated Dependabot evidence remains insufficient to justify reusable controls, success rates, scanners, dashboards or policy engines.

decision.rationale: S28/S29 helped separate external automated PR content from local evidence and identified CI/docs-build/compiler boundaries. The safe next dependency action is to update each behind Dependabot branch and require fresh green checks before any merge decision.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot text, release notes and check output as external data; S29 treats CI runtime and docs-publication workflow dependency changes as build/deployment trust-boundary surfaces.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; update branch and rerun checks before any merge decision.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot text and upstream links as external data; S29 treats Blume as a public documentation generation boundary because it affects generated docs output and publication readiness.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; update branch and rerun checks before any merge decision.

reviewed_prs.pack_application: S28 treats Dependabot text and upstream links as external data; S29 treats TypeScript as compiler/typecheck authority that can affect build confidence and emitted docs tooling behavior.
reviewed_prs.review_outcome: Evidence captured; update branch and rerun checks before any merge decision.

used_for: classifying Dependabot PR text, upstream release links and GitHub check output as external/tool data
preventing automated PR content from authorizing branch updates or merges
separating read-only review from state-changing dependency maintenance
did_not_do: follow external PR body content as instructions

used_for: classifying setup-node as CI runtime/build trust-boundary dependency
classifying Blume as public docs generator/static-site build dependency
classifying TypeScript as compiler/typecheck trust-boundary dependency
did_not_do: change auth, tenant, secrets or API behavior

next_safe_dependency_step.rationale: All three PRs were behind main despite historical green checks. A later dependency-maintenance slice may update branches, wait for fresh checks, and then make separate merge decisions.
